defect: The new Futex.cpp stores the long result of syscall() in an int (int rv = syscall(...)), which fails the clang build under RocksDB's -Wshorten-64-to-32 with -Werror.
reason: The fix changes exactly these added declarations to long and casts the return, repairing a compile failure that this new file introduced.

defect: BackgroundCallPurge iterates purge_files_ with a range-for while unlocking and relocking mutex_ inside the loop, so other threads can modify the map and invalidate the iterator/reference (use-after-free, double delete).
reason: The fix replaces this change's range-for with a while(!empty) loop that copies and erases the entry before unlocking, and its message names this PR as the culprit.

defect: The fix removes template arguments from constructor names (ProtectionInfoKVO<T>(...)), which newer gcc/clang reject; this change only added 'explicit' to such constructors.
reason: The template-id constructor declarations, including the untouched default constructors the fix also edits, existed before this change, so the defect was pre-existing.

defect: The fix strips the leading '/' from TableFileName/LogFileName("", n) and dedups all_files so the same file is not renamed/deleted twice; this change mostly renamed variables.
reason: The TableFileName("", ...) / LogFileName("", ...) pattern and the duplicate entries existed before this change (purge_log_after_memtable_flush defaulted to true), so nothing new was broken here.

defect: The fix removes a duplicate declaration of count created when a later commit (c0cb289) added 'int count __attribute__((unused)) = 0;' next to this change's debug-only 'int count=0;'.
reason: This change compiled correctly by itself; the redeclaration was produced by the later mis-merged commit c0cb289, not by these lines alone.

defect: The fix renames the constructor parameter table_options to _table_options because it shadows the member function table_options() and drops a stray semicolon.
reason: At this change the accessor was still named GetTableOptions(); the shadowing only appeared when commit 84992d6 renamed it to table_options(), so this change did not introduce the build break.

defect: The fix only reformats the static option maps this change added (trailing whitespace, clang-format layout).
reason: The fix's hunks in this file are pure style changes; no defect in this change's lines is repaired here.

defect: The fix replaces bbtf->GetTableOptions() with bbtf->table_options() after a parallel branch renamed the accessor.
reason: GetTableOptions() existed when this test was written (84992d6 was not its ancestor); the break came from merging the rename in the option-helper refactor.

defect: Converting NewFileNumber to atomics as fetch_add(1) + 1 changed its semantics from next_file_number_++ to ++next_file_number_, so current_next_file_number() returns an already-allocated number and ReuseLogFileNumber's CAS can never match.
reason: The fix restores fetch_add(1) and states the change mistakenly altered the returned file number; the off-by-one is in this change's lines and visible against the removed post-increment.

defect: The new JNI functions setWriteThreadMaxYieldUsec declare a parameter named jobject of type jobject, shadowing the JNI typedef, which breaks the Java build under -Wshadow -Werror.
reason: The fix 'Fix java build' only renames these parameters to jobj; the shadowing declarations were added by this change (committed 4 days before the fix).

defect: The new setOptions JNI function declares a local 'jstring jvalue', shadowing the JNI type jvalue from jni.h and breaking the Java build under -Wshadow -Werror.
reason: The fix 'Fix java build' renames exactly this local to jval; recognizing jvalue as a JNI type needs jni.h.

defect: CompressionTypeSupported returns LZ4_Supported() for kZSTDNotFinalCompression instead of ZSTD_Supported().
reason: The copy-paste error is in the case line this change added and the fix replaces it with ZSTD_Supported().

defect: The fix makes TestGetEntity compare against pre/post-read expected values (fuzzy match) because key locking was removed from read tests by a later PR (#12709).
reason: The exact-match verification predates this change and was correct while the key lock was held; it became wrong only after the later lock removal.

defect: TransactionDBMutexImpl locks through a single shared std::unique_lock member used by all threads, whose non-atomic owns flag makes concurrent lock()/unlock() race (and unique_lock::lock throws if already owned), breaking transaction locking.
reason: The fix removes the shared unique_lock and uses the mutex directly with an adopt_lock unique_lock in the cond-var wait, undoing exactly what this change introduced ('Broke transaction locking in 4.4').

defect: The new test SwitchMemtableRaceWithNewManifest calls SetOptions(), which returns NotSupported in ROCKSDB_LITE, so the test fails in LITE builds.
reason: The fix rewrites the test added by this change to use a compaction instead of SetOptions; knowing that SetOptions is unsupported in LITE needs DBImpl.

defect: WALDumper::DoCommand calls row.clear() to reset the stringstream, which only clears error flags, so each output line repeats all previous records.
reason: The fix replaces row.clear() with row.str("") in the code this change added.

defect: The fix stops FindPrevUserEntry from reseeking to saved_key_ after skipping more than max_skip_ entries that are newer than the read sequence, which made Prev() loop forever.
reason: The unconditional reseek that causes the hang existed before this change; the change only added a per-iteration flag for the deletion case and did not make the hang possible.

defect: The fix closes a coverage hole: the WAL-recovery timestamp test did not verify timestamps because default flush during recovery stripped them.
reason: The fix improves test coverage; nothing in this change's test failed or misbehaved.

defect: The fix passes stats and clock to GenerateOneFileChecksum so the verify-file-checksums read histogram gets populated; in this file it just adapts the ingestion call sites.
reason: The ingestion checksum path recorded no read stats before or after this change; the missing stat belongs to the VerifyFileChecksums path, so no defect in this file's changed lines is repaired.

defect: The fix makes GenerateOneFileChecksum's RandomAccessFileReader record SST_READ_MICROS with real stats and clock; this change only replaced the histogram placeholder 0 with HISTOGRAM_ENUM_MAX while stats stayed nullptr.
reason: Stats were nullptr both before and after this change, and the unpopulated verify-checksum stat was added later by #11444, so this change introduced nothing the fix repairs.

defect: The fix retunes DifferentWriteBufferSizes (write buffer size, number of puts) because the flush trigger for CF 3 became flaky.
reason: The fix states the flakiness started after a later skip-list optimization changed memory accounting, so this change's parameters were not broken when written.

defect: The fix ensures a non-empty DB ID when the IDENTITY file is truncated (and restructures SetDBId), a crash made possible by the later #9990 requirement of a non-empty DB ID.
reason: Reading an empty ID from a truncated IDENTITY file predates this change, which only moved the manifest write into the recovery context; the read-only path was already mishandled before (LogAndApply on a read-only DB).

defect: The new test binds Slice begin = Key(0) and end = Key(1) to temporary strings that are destroyed immediately, leaving dangling slices (ASAN stack-use-after-scope).
reason: The fix stores the keys in local std::string variables first; the dangling slices are in lines this change added.

defect: The fix replaces UnpinPreviousScanBlocks, which unpins blocks [prev_start, curr_start) and can unpin a block a later scan still needs when ranges are empty or seeks are relaxed.
reason: At this change, seeks not matching the scan start aborted MultiScan and middle ranges could not be empty, so the unpinned-block access only became reachable after later commits (#14040, #14046).

defect: The destructor calls window_stats_.release() on a unique_ptr<HistogramStat[]>, leaking the window array (plus a static global bucketMapper used for the min reset).
reason: The fix empties the destructor and removes the global bucketMapper, both introduced in this new file.

defect: Changing bucket_to_replace_pos to uint32_t makes 'while (bucket_to_replace_pos >= 0)' always true, which clang rejects (-Wtautological-compare with -Werror), breaking the Mac build.
reason: The fix 'Fixing broken Mac build' rewrites exactly this loop condition introduced by this change.

defect: The fix adds override and the target_path_id parameter so DBImplReadOnly::CompactRange again overrides DB::CompactRange.
reason: At this change the signature matched DB::CompactRange; it stopped overriding only when f6b7e1e (2014-07-16) added target_path_id.

defect: The fix only reformats the new backup C API wrappers.
reason: The fix is a pure formatting change.

defect: The new test prints int64_t values with %ld, which fails the Mac build (int64_t is long long) under -Wformat -Werror.
reason: The fix 'Fix mac compile' replaces these format specifiers with PRIi64 in the fprintf this change added.

defect: This change added the ResetPrefixSeekKey mechanism, with which MergingIterator reseeks children to a stored prefix_seek_key_ that can be larger than the current key for the same user key, causing an assertion failure in Prev().
reason: The fix removes the ResetPrefixSeekKey hook declared here together with its merger.cc/db_iter.cc uses, all introduced by this change; the faulty behavior is in those other files.

defect: InitFromCmdLineArgs lost its default Options() argument and gained a required LDBOptions parameter, so existing callers such as reduce_levels_test.cc (InitFromCmdLineArgs(args)) no longer compile.
reason: The fix restores default arguments for both parameters; the broken caller is in another file.

defect: GetRandomizedMutableCFOptionsMap calls test::RandomInitCFOptions, which allocates a compaction filter that is never deleted, leaking under valgrind/ASAN.
reason: The fix deletes options.compaction_filter in the helper this change added; that RandomInitCFOptions allocates it is only visible in testutil.

defect: NewIterator and Get call GetTableReaderFromHandle(handle) before checking FindTable's status, so a failed lookup dereferences a null handle (segfault).
reason: The fix moves the status check before GetTableReaderFromHandle in exactly the lines this change reordered.

defect: The fix makes EncodedFileMetaData carry table_reader instead of table_reader_handle after D17961 switched TableCache to FileMetaData::table_reader.
reason: Passing table_reader_handle was correct when this change was made; the regression came from D17961 (fa430bf), as the fix title says.

defect: The fix adds missing crash-test options and only renames this change's restore Options variable to db_opt to make room for a RestoreOptions variable.
reason: The fix is a feature/coverage change; nothing in this change's PrepareOptionsForRestoredDB logic is repaired.

defect: The fix randomizes IngestExternalFileOptions in the stress test and adds them to the error message this change moved.
reason: The fix is a test-coverage feature; the change's handling of injected ingestion errors is not repaired.

defect: The fix replaces max_write_buffer_number=-15K, whose unit parsing left-shifts a negative value (UBSAN).
reason: The -15K input was already in the test before this change, which only dropped the memtable_prefix_bloom_bits part of that string.

defect: kMicrosInSec is defined outside the ROCKSDB_LITE guard while all its uses are inside it, so it is an unused const variable that clang rejects (-Wunused-const-variable with -Werror) in LITE builds, and in all clang builds once the tests moved away.
reason: The fix deletes exactly this added constant; the LITE build was already broken at this change, though the failure surfaced when 671d15c moved the stats tests out.

defect: NewBuilder uses an undeclared identifier table_opt (copied from the builder) instead of the fixture's table_options_, so the test does not compile.
reason: The fix renames table_opt to table_options_ in the lines this change added; the leak the fix also repairs predates the change.

defect: The fix repairs a MultiGet duplicate-key bug in version_set.cc and only moves and parameterizes the test flush-block-policy classes in this file.
reason: This change only removed redundant 'virtual' keywords; the fix's edits here are test restructuring for a bug elsewhere.
